name: PR771 unit call scoped filtered set
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL (n) { WITH n WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = 1 } RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

name: PR771 unit call legacy inner match filter
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL { WITH n MATCH (n) WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = 1 } RETURN count(*) AS c

name: PR771 unit call all inner rows filtered
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL (n) { WITH n WHERE false SET n.k = 1 } RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

name: PR771 unit call multiple inner rows
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL (n) { WITH n UNWIND [1, 2] AS value WITH n, value WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = value } RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

name: PR771 returning call still filters outer rows
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL (n) { WITH n WHERE n.id = 2 RETURN n.id AS inner } RETURN n.id AS id, inner

name: PR771 unit call empty outer input
query: MATCH (n:Missing) CALL (n) { WITH n WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = 1 } RETURN count(*) AS c

name: PR771 transactional unit call scoped filtered set
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL (n) { WITH n WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = 1 } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROW RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id

name: PR771 transactional unit call legacy filtered set
query: MATCH (n:T) CALL { WITH n WITH n WHERE n.id = 2 SET n.k = 1 } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROW RETURN n.id AS id ORDER BY id
